# Context Radar MCP **See how full your Antigravity context really is, why a turn got slow, and when it's actually worth compacting or starting fresh.** [![CI](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/context-radar-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/context-radar-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](assets/release-badge.svg)](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/context-radar-mcp/releases) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-macOS%20%7C%20Linux-555) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
## What it does Long Antigravity sessions slow down and get expensive when context bloats or the prompt cache breaks silently. Context Radar adds a live side panel and MCP tools so you and your agent can spot cache misses, trim bloated history safely, and compact or start fresh only when it pays off. - **Live 4-state telemetry & headroom**: Tracks main sessions and running subagents (`ready`, `running` [LLM / Tool / Compacting], `waiting`, `error`), remaining context headroom, thinking vs. response token split, Stream/E2E speed, loop rollups, and estimated cost in real time. - **Slow-turn & cross-model diagnostics**: Distinguishes normal new-turn misses, mid-loop cache breaks, and post-compact rebuilds, flags cross-model `/compact` cache resets, and shows checkpoint summary size (`KB`). - **Hotspot analysis & prefix-safe distillation**: Pinpoints turns that caused context spikes and saves short digests to `scratch/` without breaking the live prompt KV cache. - **Gated `/compact` & fresh-chat handoffs**: Evaluates model budgets and break-even economics before triggering `/compact` or a new-chat handoff via official protocols only. - **Optional guardrails**: Prevents short shell commands from being backgrounded too early and optionally injects a workspace status note at session start. ## Install ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/context-radar-mcp/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` Installs the SHA-256 verified prebuilt binary (macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, Linux x86_64) into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/context-radar-mcp`. Reload Antigravity afterward. Set `CONTEXT_RADAR_VERSION=vX.Y.Z` or `ANTIGRAVITY_PLUGINS_DIR=...` to pin a release or custom folder. ## Usage Open **Context Radar** from the Antigravity side pane, or ask your agent directly—e.g. *"Why did the last few turns get slow?"*, *"Find bloated turns and summarize them"*, or *"Is it worth running `/compact` now?"*. | Tool | What it does | | :--- | :--- | | `context_radar_overview` | Opens the live panel and returns 4-state status, headroom, thinking share, Stream/E2E speed, loop rollup, and subagents. | | `context_radar_turns` | Breaks down per-turn tokens, thinking/response split, cache hits, cold-cache causes, speed, and cost. | | `context_radar_hotspots` | Finds the biggest context spikes and distills selected slices into `scratch/`. | | `context_radar_prepare_handoff` | Checks whether `/compact` or a fresh session breaks even right now. | | `context_radar_commit_handoff` | Runs hard gates and issues a scoped single-use `/compact` or new-chat handoff grant. | ### Compaction & Handoff (Official Protocols Only) - **Antigravity App (SEP-1865 `ui/message`)**: Once hard gates pass (`running_subagent_count == 0`, budget & break-even satisfied), a visibly mounted inline handoff card (`ui://context-radar-mcp/handoff`) or matching-owner side pane (`!document.hidden`) claims the single-use grant to dispatch `/compact` (with automatic clipboard fallback) or open a fresh chat (`com.google.antigravity/message`, `target: "new"`). Because Antigravity App does not mount hidden headless iframes for collapsed tool calls and exposes no headless MCP/hook `/compact` API, unattended compaction without an open UI view requires ACP below. - **`agy` CLI & ACP editors (ACP v1 `session/prompt`)**: For Antigravity CLI (`agy`) and ACP editors (Zed, JetBrains, Android Studio, Xcode, VS Code ACP), point your custom ACP agent at `acp-proxy` (instead of `agy acp`) so granted `auto_fire` compactions inject native `/compact` in-place on the same connection without concurrent session conflicts, or run unattended tasks with `acp-run`: ```json { "command": "~/.gemini/config/plugins/context-radar-mcp/bin/context-radar-mcp", "args": ["acp-proxy"] } ``` ```sh ~/.gemini/config/plugins/context-radar-mcp/bin/context-radar-mcp acp-run \ --cwd /path/to/project --auto-approve --prompt "Implement and verify the migration" ``` ## Configuration & Safety No config file is needed out of the box—language (`en` / `zh-CN`), currency (`USD` / `CNY`), and Antigravity data dirs (`~/.gemini/antigravity{,-ide,-cli}`) are auto-detected. Copy [settings.example.json](settings.example.json) to `~/.config/context-radar-mcp/settings.json` for custom pricing, thresholds, or startup notes (or set `CONTEXT_RADAR_DATA_ROOT` / `CONTEXT_RADAR_CONFIG`). - **100% local & read-only**: Zero network requests or telemetry; reads Antigravity SQLite ledgers with `SQLITE_OPEN_READ_ONLY` plus read-only WAL/JSONL tailing. - **Prefix-safe `scratch/` distillation**: Writes summaries out-of-band instead of mutating history, keeping the live KV prefix hot while fresh chats or subagents read digests on demand. - **Scoped grants & safe guards**: Single-use grants bind to `conversation_id` + `workspace` in `0600` local files; the optional `PreToolUse` wait guard exempts explicit daemons and async builds automatically. ## Build from source Requires Rust (`cargo`) and Node.js 20+ (only to bundle and test the panel). ```sh git clone https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/context-radar-mcp.git && cd context-radar-mcp node panel/pack.mjs && node --test panel/panel.test.mjs cargo test --locked && cargo build --release --locked ``` Contributions are welcome — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md), [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md), and [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).

# Context Radar MCP **看清 Antigravity 的上下文到底占了多少、为什么突然变慢，以及什么时候才值得 `/compact` 或开新对话。** [![CI](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/context-radar-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/context-radar-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](assets/release-badge.svg)](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/context-radar-mcp/releases) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-macOS%20%7C%20Linux-555) [English](README.md) | 简体中文
## 它能帮你做什么 Antigravity 长对话一旦上下文膨胀或提示词缓存悄悄断掉，就会变慢且费用飙升。Context Radar 提供实时侧边栏面板和 MCP 工具，让你和 Agent 看清缓存与水位变化，只在真正划算时整理历史或压缩会话。 - **实时四态遥测与余量监控**：实时展示主会话与运行中子 Agent 的四态运行/压缩状态（`ready` / `running` [LLM·工具·压缩中] / `waiting` / `error`）、上下文余量、思考与正文输出占比、流式/端到端速度、本轮多步循环汇总及估算费用。 - **定位变慢原因与跨模型压缩提示**：自动区分新轮次正常未命中、对话中途意外断缓存与压缩后首次重建，识别跨模型 `/compact` 缓存重置并展示检查点摘要体积（`KB`）。 - **热点排查与不破缓存提炼**：定位撑大上下文的轮次，将早期冗长历史浓缩为简短摘要存入 `scratch/`，保持当前会话 KV 前缀完整复用。 - **带门槛的 `/compact` 与新会话交接**：结合模型预算与回本轮数判断是否值得操作，严格通过官方协议执行 `/compact` 或新对话交接。 - **可选护栏**：温和提醒避免把短命令过早转入后台，并支持在会话启动时自动注入自定义工作区状态文件。 ## 安装 ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/context-radar-mcp/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` 脚本会下载经 SHA-256 校验的预编译程序（支持 macOS Apple Silicon、macOS Intel、Linux x86_64）并安装到 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/context-radar-mcp`，完成后重启或重载 Antigravity 即可。可通过 `CONTEXT_RADAR_VERSION=vX.Y.Z` 或 `ANTIGRAVITY_PLUGINS_DIR=...` 指定版本或安装目录。 ## 怎么用 在侧边栏打开 **Context Radar** 面板，或直接对 Agent 提问，例如 *"刚才几轮怎么这么慢？"*、*"找出最占上下文的轮次并整理摘要"* 或 *"现在适合 `/compact` 吗？"*。 | 工具 | 作用 | | :--- | :--- | | `context_radar_overview` | 打开实时面板，返回四态状态、上下文余量、思考占比、流式/端到端速度、本轮循环汇总与子 Agent 概览。 | | `context_radar_turns` | 按轮次拆分 Token 占用、思考/正文占比、缓存命中、冷启动原因、速度与估算费用。 | | `context_radar_hotspots` | 定位上下文激增片段，并按需将选定区间提炼为摘要写入 `scratch/`。 | | `context_radar_prepare_handoff` | 评估当前执行 `/compact` 或开新对话是否满足预算与回本条件。 | | `context_radar_commit_handoff` | 校验硬门槛后签发作用域绑定的单次 `/compact` 或新对话交接票据。 | ### 自主压缩与交接（仅使用官方协议） - **Antigravity App（SEP-1865 `ui/message`）**：通过全部硬门槛（`running_subagent_count == 0`、预算与回本达标）后，可见挂载的内联交接卡片（`ui://context-radar-mcp/handoff`）或归属匹配的侧边栏（`!document.hidden`）会核销单次票据并触发 `/compact`（失败自动复制兜底）或拉起新对话（`com.google.antigravity/message`，`target: "new"`）。由于 Antigravity App 不会为折叠工具调用静默挂载无头 iframe，也未提供无 UI 的 MCP/Hook `/compact` 接口，无人值守压缩需使用下方官方 ACP 方案。 - **`agy` CLI 与 ACP 编辑器（ACP v1 `session/prompt`）**：在 Antigravity CLI（`agy`）及支持 ACP 的编辑器（Zed、JetBrains、Android Studio、Xcode、VS Code ACP）中，将自定义 ACP Agent 指向 `acp-proxy`（替代 `agy acp`），即可在同一连接上自动核销 `auto_fire` 票据并原地执行原生 `/compact`；也可通过 `acp-run` 无头托管长任务： ```json { "command": "~/.gemini/config/plugins/context-radar-mcp/bin/context-radar-mcp", "args": ["acp-proxy"] } ``` ```sh ~/.gemini/config/plugins/context-radar-mcp/bin/context-radar-mcp acp-run \ --cwd /path/to/project --auto-approve --prompt "完成迁移并运行完整验证" ``` ## 自定义配置与安全边界 开箱即用，自动识别系统语言（`en` / `zh-CN`）、币种（`USD` / `CNY`）以及 Antigravity 数据目录（`~/.gemini/antigravity{,-ide,-cli}`）。如需自定义单价、预警阈值或启动提示，可将 [settings.example.json](settings.example.json) 复制到 `~/.config/context-radar-mcp/settings.json`（或通过 `CONTEXT_RADAR_DATA_ROOT` / `CONTEXT_RADAR_CONFIG` 覆盖）。 - **纯本地只读访问**：零网络请求、零遥测；严格使用 `SQLITE_OPEN_READ_ONLY` 只读打开会话数据库，并增量 tail WAL/JSONL 日志。 - **不破缓存的 `scratch/` 旁路提炼**：不删改线上历史消息，而是将旧片段提炼到 `scratch/`，保住当前 KV 前缀热缓存并供新会话或子 Agent 按需读取。 - **作用域票据与安全护栏**：单次交接票据绑定 `conversation_id` 与 `workspace` 并以 `0600` 权限存盘；可选 `PreToolUse` 等待守护自动放行后台守护进程与异步构建。 ## 从源码构建 需要 Rust（`cargo`）和 Node.js 20+（仅用于打包和测试前端面板）。 ```sh git clone https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/context-radar-mcp.git && cd context-radar-mcp node panel/pack.mjs && node --test panel/panel.test.mjs cargo test --locked && cargo build --release --locked ``` 欢迎提 PR 或反馈问题，详情见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)、[CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) 和 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。本项目基于 [MIT License](LICENSE) 开源。
